opening_question_spark: If a human grew huge, would their body cool the same way?
book_transition: The size clue leads into a body comparison world.
body: A giant human outline stands beside a smaller one.
Both bodies show temperature markers and heat loss.
A larger body has more outside area to lose heat.
Its inside grows too, but not the same way.
Scientists call this the square-cube rule.
Size changes body proportions, not only height.
An elephant-sized human may struggle with body heat.
It may need a different way to stay cool.
The models reveal why bigger bodies change.
full_narration: If a human grew huge, would their body cool the same way? The size clue leads into a body comparison world. A giant human outline stands beside a smaller one.
